SECTION: FMRCT01 §0C — eligibility proxy and parent-present conditional
MATURATION_PROXY_IS_AN_UPPER_BOUND: the FDFLT01 mass-ratio clause cannot be recomputed from these archives, so the proxy trigger is more permissive than the real one
WHY_THIS_IS_NOT_THE_QUANTITY_FMRCT01_MEA: every number here is measured with the parent still present. Under the strict link rule a second centre inside CORE_R of both previous centroids terminates BOTH identities, so the parent is itself the dominant source of daughter identity termination. Selective parent removal deletes that source. The developmental figure is therefore expected to understate the post-removal rate, and no existing dataset can measure the post-removal rate at all: FMRT01 held only 250 steps after removal and FDOT01 never removed a parent.
